mcplink.config.title: MCP Link
mcplink.config.reading_indicator.tooltip: Show the blue "MCP: reading" tag in the corner while the agent is reading the game.
mcplink.config.control_indicator.tooltip: Show the orange "MCP: control ON" tag (with what the agent is doing) while control is switched on.
mcplink.config.control_messages.tooltip: Action-bar messages when control is switched on or off, or when your own movement stops the agent.
mcplink.config.keep_running.tooltip: While control is on, don't open the pause menu when the game window loses focus. Without this, the agent's walking and mining stop whenever you switch to another window (with Pause on Lost Focus on).
mcplink.config.packets_per_type.tooltip: How many of the most recent packets of each type are kept for the packets tool. Chunk and light data keep at most 8.
mcplink.config.scripts.tooltip: Let the JavaScript scripts the agent installs run inside your game. They can do anything the game can: watch and act, chat, attack, and drop, change or send packets, whether or not control is on. Off until you turn it on.
mcplink.config.auto_start_scripts.toolti: Scripts that were on start again when the game launches. While this is off, every script is switched off at launch, so a script that crashes the game can't do it again on the next start. Switch them back on under Scripts...
mcplink.scripts.title: MCP Link Scripts
mcplink.scripts.off: Scripts are off: turn on Allow Scripts first
mcplink.scripts.none: No scripts installed yet (ask your agent for one)
